15:   constructor(private payments: PaymentGateway, private db: Db) {}

17:   async checkout(items: CartItem[], paymentToken: string, operatorId: string, operatorIp: string, discountCode?: string) {
18:     if (!items.length) throw new Error("empty cart");
19:     if (!operatorId?.trim() || !operatorIp?.trim()) throw new Error("missing operator identity");
20: 
21:     let total = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.priceCents * item.qty, 0);
22:     if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) throw new Error("invalid order total");
23: 
24:     let discountCents = 0;
25:     if (discountCode) {
26:       const rows = await this.db.query("SELECT percentOff, expiresAt FROM discount_codes WHERE code = ?", [discountCode]);
27:       if (!rows.length) throw new Error("invalid discount code");
28:       const discount = rows[0] as DiscountCode;
29:       if (!Number.isFinite(discount.percentOff) || discount.percentOff < 0 || discount.percentOff > 100) {
30:         throw new Error("invalid discount percentage");
31:       }
32:       if (!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(discount.expiresAt)) || Date.parse(discount.expiresAt) <= Date.now()) {
33:         throw new Error("expired discount code");
34:       }
35:       discountCents = Math.min(total, Math.round((total * discount.percentOff) / 100));
36:       total -= discountCents;
37:     }

40:     if (!result.ok) return { status: "payment_failed" as const, error: result.error };
